title: Kimberly-Clark completes $48.7 billion acquisition of Kenvue
summary: The acquisition marks Kimberly-Clark’s expansion into the beauty category, and will see Kenvue’s health and beauty brands Neutrogena, Aveeno, OGX and Listerine sit under the same umbrella as Kenvue’s personal care brands

extraction.key_fact: Kimberly-Clark가 Kenvue 인수를 마치고 뷰티 분야로 사업을 넓혔다.
extraction.key_fact_quote: The acquisition marks Kimberly-Clark’s expansion into the beauty category
